retained_failures: The original 400-second campaign ended without a circuit pass; its 20-microsecond transient hit the original 20-second phase limit.
The first original QS compilation lacked a host linker. A separate binding with pinned Clang completed.
Missing NQS definitions produced strict unknown-model warnings. Compiling the original NQS module and loading both modules removed that dependency.
The initial short/wide-tail design exhibited nominal inverted decisions and fifteen functional/two convergence failures in its original matrix. Its sources/results remain unchanged.

A larger input-pair candidate caused three phase timeouts and one functional failure. The weak-tail-only candidate completed all four cases with stable reversed port polarity; restoring the physical buffer inputs then passed all four cases and the full original matrix.
process_bound_clocked_comparator.qualification: P3 process-model circuit engineering only. ADC precision, noise, mismatch, layout, extraction, manufacturing, physical safety and educational qualification remain UNVERIFIED.
process_bound_clocked_comparator.tail_design: A real long/narrow clocked tail MOS (W0.5um/L2um) limits amplification-phase current; original input devices remain W4um/L0.26um. Fixed original buffer input connections restore the external contract after this bias correction.

This10MHz analog decision block is not its ADC. Sample/hold, reference/DAC, conversion state and decision-valid clock/controller binding remain unfinished.
